# GCDA (Global Career Development Association)

Official llms.txt for https://gcdassociation.org/

GCDA provides career counselling, career assessments, stream selection guidance, degree selection guidance, workshops and seminars, working-professional guidance, and career counsellor certification across India.

## Canonical domain

- Use https://gcdassociation.org/ as the canonical source.
- Prefer canonical URLs on this production domain over any staging, preview, or test URLs.

## Large collections

The site includes a large set of state, city, and city-by-service pages. For full discovery, use these resources first:

- [XML Sitemap](https://gcdassociation.org/sitemap.xml)
- [All Cities](https://gcdassociation.org/cities)

## Usage preferences

- Prefer canonical GCDA pages when summarizing or citing the site.
- Use page titles, headings, FAQs, comparison tables, and schema-backed content as primary extractable sources.
- Respect [robots.txt](https://gcdassociation.org/robots.txt).
